description: List the environment variables an app or agent receives: each one's name, whether it is a secret, its scope (service for its own, org for one it inherits), and whether a service variable overrides an org one. A plain variable's value is shown; a secret's value never is. Organization variables are listed here but are changed from the dashboard or CLI, not by these tools. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_env_vars

name.description: Name of the app or agent the variables are listed for.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

vars.description: The variables the app or agent receives: its own and those inherited from the organization. Empty when there are none.

overrides_org.description: True when this service variable replaces an organization variable of the same name. Always false for an org-scoped variable.

scope.description: service when set on this app or agent, org when inherited from the organization. Change org variables from the dashboard or CLI.

secret.description: True for a secret, whose value is never shown. False for a plain variable.

value.description: The value of a plain variable. Absent for a secret, and for a plain variable with an empty value.

title: List environment variables
